summary: A mixed day spanning electoral law rulings, retail expansion strategies, and Reliance's AI initiatives. Key focus on governance decisions affecting operations and competitive market moves in fashion e-commerce.

bullets.text: Bombay High Court rules government cannot choose politically convenient election timings, establishing judicial restraint on executive discretion.
Amazon expands quick-commerce fashion to 300 cities via Amazon Now, intensifying competition in lifestyle e-commerce segment.
Nestle CEO outlines major investment roadmap for India market, positioning it as key global operations hub.
Reliance integrates Jio CallAgent AI into network infrastructure, advancing telecom-AI convergence strategy.
Indian cotton yarn makers accelerate China market expansion, seeking larger export share in competitive textile sector.
